name: What is the difference between modular and custom garage cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between modular and custom garage cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modular garage cabinets are pre-manufactured units that come in standard sizes and configurations, offering a more budget-friendly and quicker installation option. Custom garage cabinets, on the other hand, are designed and built specifically to fit your unique space and storage needs, often maximizing every inch and accommodating specific items or architectural features. While modular provides efficiency, custom solutions offer tailored functionality and aesthetics. Considering what specific items you need to store can help you decide which option best suits your garage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modular cabinets are pre-made, standard sizes, offering a quicker and more budget-friendly option. Custom cabinets are built to fit your unique space and storage needs.
